description: Return the credit balance, recent priced calls with their credits, and costModel (the one-sentence rule of what costs credits). THE RULE: only AI model runs and Ad Spy research spend credits; publishing, scheduling, ads management, analytics, comments, DMs and connectors cost no credits on any plan (X is the single per-call exception; xCost gives its exact credits per post, with and without a link). Check before kicking off paid generation; answer "does posting cost credits?" with NO. HOW MANY posts is set by the plan, not credits: the Free plan includes 10 posts a month on up to 3 channels, and a post counts once however many channels it goes to (`posting` says how many are used); every paid plan posts without a limit and runs autopilot (Basic $9.99/mo: unlimited posting and Autopilot, no monthly credits; it includes the same 160 free credits as the Free plan, and monthly credits start on Starter). Starter, Pro and Studio: media models at cost + 10% (memberRate); Basic and Free pay standard prices.
